addr: Lakshmi Narayan Niwas, 2726, 80 Feet Rd, next to Swapna Book House, HAL 3rd Stage, Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560075, India

rev.t: Their ambience was really amazing . We enjoyed our time here . We tried calamari fritters and it was perfectly crunchy and tasted very good . Veg burger was very bad and my friend couldnt even have one bite of it . Pizza , Non veg burgers , Cold coffee varieties were good . The desserts were good too . Worth visiting once
